Ancestry: Gargoyle Heritage: Dhampir Class: Laughing Shadow Magus | Paradox of Opposites Seneschal Witch Age: 229 Backstory Mira had a very long life. Beginning as the unborn twin to her dhampiric sister, somehow not dead but really alive either. Lacking a body to call her own. A trapped soul. Oddly fitting, given their heritage. Mira's only escape from this non-existence was being cast upon a wall, as her sister's living shadow. They both descend from so called "psychic vampires" or so they heard, the magicks her sister gained later in life did nothing but reaffirm that, but it sure was an easy way to explain their circumstance. In a way, they could simply not be without one and the other. Maybe her sister had the literal brains but Mira was the mastermind behind their every move, her consciousness, guide to greater power and magical prowess. Her sister provided being in the moment, corporeal and much needed levity, for the two of them. It also helped that she was pretty to boot, very skilled at talking to people. They made a pretty great team, as best as they could manage, even if her beloved sister took all of the credit at times. Their hard earned work but she was fine for the longest time. That was until they fell hard for the same woman and Mira of course, let her sister take charge. To enjoy what she could never have but the sheet strain this put between them was something that tore them apart. Miriam certainly sought to make that literal, she had enough with having to "share" her every little joy, give it all away. It took a lot of pain, effort, blood, sweat, tears but also, reconciliation and negotiation. Mira and her sister had managed to sever themselves, one from the other, together as it turns out, as a team once more. A gradual process, as Miriam was granted a sad little familiar to embody at first but being corporeal outweighed anything making her uncomfortable. She even revealed herself to her sister's love afterwards and somehow, the three of them made it work. It all worked out in the end and Miriam became more and more real. Day by day, with both occult study, friendships earned and memories made, she gained a body all her own. She became more real than real. But as the years went on and on, her hunger for knowledge and magic was not satisfied, the spring in her step did not falter. Learning to do magicks all on her own, learning to do quite a lot without her sister actually, they sure had less and less time spent together as things moved forward, even less time to share with their wife. Why can't she remember their faces? They kept slowing down, trailing behind her.... By the time she had forgotten their names. The regret crushed her the most, things left unsaid, mistakes made over the decades, so much hurt, and yet. Mira could not stop in her pursuit for higher power by that point, it was all she had left. Alone. Diving into ancient, forbidden tome after forbidden tome. Making pacts with higher powers left and right. Looking at god right in the eye and asking them why? Why all this? -# All she ever wanted was to... Then, she blacked out, Mira can't remember when it happened exactly nor how but yes, she had woken up in unknown lands that she would later come to know as Ao . All Mira could recall was a blurry mess, the night prior. There was laughter though, so much laughter, cruel and wicked. A dreadful feeling that would not leave her, even now. She was lost here, but not alone, for Mira had come with a companion of sorts. A thing she has never known nor seen before but instinctually, she held onto her tiny paws, looked into those beady little eyes and silly little pink horn for a nose. Mira knew at that moment that she could not let go of her now. Her little Luz... She is not sure where the name came from exactly but it was comforting, somehow. The pair made their way forward henceforth. Together again. "Kobold!" 1:17 AM Uhh idk what other info to provide but i used player 229 to make both of their sheets.
